arxiv-1507-03677.title: RAESON: A Tool for Reasoning Tasks Driven by Interactive Visualization of Logical Structure
arxiv-1507-03677.creator: Ştefan Minică
arxiv-1507-03677.description: Abstract The paper presents a software tool for analysis and interactive engagement in various logical reasoning tasks. A first feature of the program consists in providing an interface for working with logic-specific repositories of formal knowledge. A second feature provides the means to intuitively visualize and interactively generate the underlying logical structure that propels customary logical reasoning tasks.

arxiv-2011-11565.title: The ℋ \mathcal{H} -tautological ring
arxiv-2011-11565.creator: Carl Lian
arxiv-2011-11565.description: Abstract . We extend the theory of tautological classes on moduli spaces of stable curves to the more general setting of moduli spaces of admissible Galois covers of curves, introducing the so-called ℋ \mathcal{H} -tautological ring. The main new feature is the existence of restriction-corestriction morphisms remembering intermediate quotients of Galois covers, which are a rich source of new classes.

arxiv-2105-06732.title: RECENT RESULTS FROM T2K
arxiv-2105-06732.creator: L. BERNS for the T2K collaboration
arxiv-2105-06732.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by L. BERNS for the T2K collaboration. We report on latest results from the Tokai-to-Kamioka experiment studying the disappearance of ν μ \nu_{\mu} and appearance of ν e \nu_{e} from neutrino oscillation with accelerator generated neutrinos. Thanks to increase in statistics and numerous upgrades to each part of the oscillation analysis, we set the most sensitive constraints on some of the oscillation parameters, including in particular the CP-violation angle δ CP \delta_{\mathrm{CP}} . Future prospects are also briefly discussed.

arxiv-2111-05688.title: Robust reconstructions by multi-scale/irregular tangential covering
arxiv-2111-05688.creator: Antoine Vacavant, Bertrand Kerautret, Fabien Feschet
arxiv-2111-05688.description: Abstract In this paper, we propose an original manner to employ a tangential cover algorithm - minDSS - in order to geometrically reconstruct noisy digital contours. To do so, we exploit the representation of graphical objects by maximal primitives we have introduced in previous works.

arxiv-2212-04834.title: Optimising graph codes for measurement-based loss tolerance
arxiv-2212-04834.creator: Tom J. Bell, Love A. Pettersson, Stefano Paesani
arxiv-2212-04834.description: Abstract Graph codes play an important role in photonic quantum technologies as they provide significant protection against qubit loss, a dominant noise mechanism. Here, we develop methods to analyse and optimise measurement-based tolerance to qubit loss and computational errors for arbitrary graph codes. Using these tools we identify optimised codes with up to 12 qubits and asymptotically-large modular constructions.

arxiv-2305-19705.title: Expulsion of counter Evershed flows from sunspot penumbrae
arxiv-2305-19705.creator: J. S. Castellanos Durán, A. Korpi-Lagg, S. K. Solanki
arxiv-2305-19705.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by J. S. Castellanos Durán, A. Korpi-Lagg, S. K. Solanki. In addition to the Evershed flow directed from the umbra towards the outer boundary of the sunspot, under special circumstances, a counter Evershed flow (CEF) in the opposite direction also occurs. We aim to characterize the proper motions and evolution of three CEFs observed by the Solar Optical Telescope onboard the Japanese Hinode spacecraft and the Helioseismic and Magnetic Imager onboard the Solar Dynamics Observatory.

arxiv-2308-05608.title: On a nonlocal two-phase flow with convective heat transfer
arxiv-2308-05608.creator: Šárka Nečasová, John Sebastian H. Simon
arxiv-2308-05608.description: Abstract We study a system describing the dynamics of a two-phase flow of incompressible viscous fluids influenced by the convective heat transfer of Caginalp-type. The separation of the fluids is expressed by the order parameter which is of diffuse interface and is known as the Cahn-Hilliard model.

arxiv-2311-00999.title: Isomorphism of Multiprojective Bundles and Projective Towers
arxiv-2311-00999.creator: Ashima Bansal, Supravat Sarkar, Shivam Vats
arxiv-2311-00999.description: Abstract We study when two projective bundles over two arbitrary smooth projective varieties of different dimensions can be isomorphic. We show that two multi-projective bundles (fibre product of projective bundles) over different projective spaces cannot be isomorphic, except in the trivial case.

arxiv-2409-13058.title: Mixed Reality Tele-Ultrasound over 750 km: A Feasibility Study
arxiv-2409-13058.creator: Ryan Yeung, David G. Black, Patrick Boyan Chen, Victoria Lessoway, Janice Reid, Sergio Rangel-Suarez, Silvia D. Chang, Septimiu E. Salcudean
arxiv-2409-13058.description: Abstract To address the lack of access to ultrasound in remote communities, previous work introduced human teleoperation, a mixed reality and haptics-based tele-ultrasound system. In this approach, a novice takes the role of a cognitive robot controlled remotely by an expert through mixed reality.

arxiv-2411-10852.title: Amplitude mode in a multi-gap superconductor MgB 2 investigated by terahertz two-dimensional coherent spectroscopy
arxiv-2411-10852.creator: Kota Katsumi, Jiahao Liang, Ralph Romero III, Ke Chen, Xiaoxing Xi, N. P. Armitage
arxiv-2411-10852.description: Abstract We have investigated terahertz (THz) nonlinear responses in a multi-gap superconductor, MgB 2 , using THz two-dimensional coherent spectroscopy (THz 2DCS). With broad-band THz drives, we identified a well-defined nonlinear response near the lower superconducting gap energy 2 ​ Δ π 2\Delta_{\pi} only at the lowest temperatures.

arxiv-2503-20994.title: Deep Learning for Forensic Identification of Source
arxiv-2503-20994.creator: Cole Patten, Christopher Saunders, Michael Puthawala
arxiv-2503-20994.description: Abstract We used contrastive neural networks to learn useful similarity scores between the 144 cartridge casings in the NBIDE dataset [ 25 ] , under the common-but-unknown source paradigm. The common-but-unknown source problem is a problem archetype in forensics where the question is whether two objects share a common source (e.g. were two cartridge casings fired from the same firearm).

pmc-11935620.creator: Hitomi Okubo, Shoji F. Nakayama, Asako Mito, Naoko Arata, Michihiro Kamijima, Michihiro Kamijima, Shin Yamazaki, Yukihiro Ohya, Reiko Kishi, Nobuo Yaegashi, Koichi Hashimoto, Chisato Mori, Shuichi Ito, Zentaro Yamagata, Hidekuni Inadera, Takeo Nakayama, Tomotaka Sobue, Masayuki Shima, Seiji Kageyama

We aimed to investigate the association between periconceptional diet quality and the risk of HDP among pregnant Japanese women.

pmc-12546801.title: Social experiences of people living with Parkinson’s disease in Ireland: A qualitative study
pmc-12546801.creator: Francesca Gaiera, Emma O’Shea, Gerard O’Keeffe, Suzanne Timmons
pmc-12546801.description: IntroductionParkinson’s disease (PD) is a neurodegenerative disorder characterized by motor and non-motor symptoms, compromising people with PD’s (PwP) quality of life and psychological well-being, which may be compounded by stigma. We sought to explore the social experiences of PwP in Ireland, including the role of stigma.MethodsTwenty-one people with PD were recruited through purposeful and snowball sampling.

pmc-12554446.title: GLP-1 receptor agonists synergistic effects of metabolic reprogramming and cardioprotection
pmc-12554446.creator: Xuan Wang, Mengmeng Qi, Lili Yang, Libo Yang, Xiaoyue Wang, Fang Zhang, Yukun Cui, Dongxin Wang, Yangang Wang, Wenshan Lv
pmc-12554446.description: Diabetes mellitus, a condition that significantly elevates the incidence and mortality risks associated with cardiovascular diseases, exacerbates the disease burden in China. Glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1RAs) have garnered considerable attention, as they not only regulate blood glucose but also play a vital role in safeguarding the cardiovascular system.

pmc-12624277.title: First‐Trimester Serum n‐3/n‐6 Fatty Acids Predict Large‐for‐Gestational‐Age Risk: A Nested Case‐Control Study
pmc-12624277.creator: Xiaxia Cai, Haiyan Zhu, Ning Liang, Yandi Zhu, Qinyu Dang, Min Gao, Huanling Yu
pmc-12624277.description: Polyunsaturated fatty acids (PUFAs) are critical for fetal development during pregnancy. This study evaluates the association between maternal serum n‐3 and n‐6 PUFAs in early pregnancy and the risk of large‐for‐gestational‐age (LGA) infants.A nested case‐control study was conducted with 45 LGA‐appropriate for gestational age (AGA) matched pairs from a cohort of 2839 pregnant women.

pmc-12733977.title: Comparative Outcomes of Apixaban and Acenocoumarol in Advanced Chronic Kidney Disease and Atrial Fibrillation: A Retrospective Observational Study
pmc-12733977.creator: Ioana Livia Suliman, Liliana-Ana Tuta, Florin Gabriel Panculescu, Andreea Alexandru, Dragos Fasie, Bogdan Cimpineanu, Georgeta Camelia Cozaru, Stere Popescu, Florin-Daniel Enache, Iulian Manac, Tatiana Chisnoiu, Luana Alexandrescu, Ion Bordeianu
pmc-12733977.description: Background: Anticoagulation in patients with advanced chronic kidney disease (CKD) and atrial fibrillation (AF) remains challenging due to the concurrent risks of thrombosis and bleeding driven by endothelial dysfunction, uremic inflammation, and impaired hemostasis. Evidence comparing vitamin K antagonists (VKAs) with direct oral anticoagulants (NOACs) in this high-risk population, particularly in dialysis, is still limited.

pmc-12751924.title: Dispatched into disaster: a qualitative study on medical rescue teams’ personnel’s preparation, mobilization, and field living conditions after the Kahramanmaraş earthquakes
pmc-12751924.creator: Ramazan Aslan
pmc-12751924.description: BackgroundEffective disaster response requires both well-prepared medical rescue teams and resilient early-phase logistics.ObjectivesThis study examined how medical rescue teams’ personnel prepared, mobilized, and maintained field living conditions after the 6 February 2023 earthquakes, aiming to generate practice- and policy-oriented recommendations.MethodsA qualitative phenomenological design with purposive maximum-variation sampling (n = 12) was utilized. Semi-structured online interviews underwent thematic analysis.

pmc-13181597.creator: Mohammad Mehdi Asgari, Mina Esmaeili, Abbas Zamani, Seyed Vali Hosseini
pmc-13181597.description: Freezing and thawing are critical techniques for preserving seafood quality and extending shelf life. This study evaluated the effects of ultrasound‐assisted (UT), water immersion (WT), and microwave (MT) thawing on physicochemical, textural, and structural quality attributes of common carp ( Cyprinus carpio ) fillets and their myofibrillar protein properties.
